name: Hotel de Berri Champs-Elysees
positioning: Hôtel de Berri Champs-Élysées, a Luxury Collection Hotel: a design-led Paris hotel steps from the Champs-Élysées, on an address once home to Elsa Schiaparelli
best_for: Travelers who want a base steps from the Champs-Élysées and the Golden Triangle
Fashion and design lovers drawn to the Schiaparelli legacy and Philippe Renaud interiors

facts.text: The hotel is steps from the Champs-Élysées.
The hotel is located steps from Paris's Golden Triangle.
Each room and suite was designed by Philippe Renaud and blends curated antiques, handcrafted textures and contemporary artworks.
The room decor blends neoclassical elegance with surrealist details.
Each suite has an Apple TV and a hi-fi speaker system.
Rooms have Toto toilets and heated Italian marble floors.
The large suites are suited to families and guests who want more space.
Le Schiap by Stéphane Pitré pays tribute to Elsa Schiaparelli through refined French cuisine.
The Luxury Collection Concierge team arranges private museum visits, curated shopping experiences and restaurant reservations.
Parc Monceau is a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
The hotel is close to the Jacquemart-André museum.
The hotel has a gym with cardio and strength equipment.

highlights.text: The hotel stands on a historic Parisian address that was once home to couturière Elsa Schiaparelli.
The Parisian Suite, inspired by Elsa Schiaparelli's residence, has views over the private garden, a dining room for six, a salon, a marble bathroom and a walk-in dressing room.
Many of the rooms and suites overlook the hotel's private garden.
The Chief Concierge curates guided tours of the hotel's surroundings for guests to rediscover the Champs-Élysées area.

considerations.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
WhataHotel notes boutique size with limited facilities compared to larger hotels.
